title: Stellar Evolution
description: Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

puzzle.goal: A star stays on the main sequence until it has burnt a fraction f of its mass M, and fusing hydrogen releases 0.7% of the burnt mass as energy. Its luminosity scales with mass to the power 3.5 relative to the Sun. Write its main-sequence lifetime as the burnt mass integrated against energy released per unit mass divided by luminosity.
puzzle.name: Stellar lifetime from the mass–luminosity relation
puzzle.ask: Find the lifetime in billions of years of a star of M = @{M} solar masses with f = @{f}.

vars.M: stellar mass (in the numeric step: in solar masses)

puzzle.method: Energy per burnt mass is 0.007c²; divide by the (constant) luminosity, which follows L ∝ M^3.5, and integrate over the burnt mass.
